description: Helps you decide whether a GTM plan is clear enough to run: it takes the text of a GTM document or plan and returns a score for each CRAFT dimension, based only on what the plan contains. Timeline counts real dates, durations and quarters; the answer shows the plan's own line for each dimension, names only the elements that are missing and suggests sections to add. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of launch_commander when you already have a GTM document to assess against CRAFT.

desired_outcome.description: Optional: What action should this document drive. Format is text. For example, "resolve invoice exceptions before month-end".

document_content.description: The GTM document or plan to analyze. Paste the full text: the tool reads it and scores it against the framework. Format is text. For example, "Launch invoice review services for manufacturers over six weeks, with a finance owner and weekly exception reviews.".

document_type.description: Type of document (shown in the analysis). Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "gtm_strategy".

industry.description: Optional: your own company's sector, so the answer uses the usual buyers, measures and objections for what you sell. Leave it out and the tool reads the sector from your other inputs and names what it read. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

intended_audience.description: Optional: Who will read/approve this document. Format is text. For example, "finance leaders at manufacturers".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

name: craft_gtm_analyzer
